# mashov-parent-brief

> Self-hosted daily school brief for Israeli parents: a deterministic Python collector pulls timetable, homework and teacher messages from Mashov (via the open pymashov library), formats one WhatsApp-style morning message per family, and your own bot delivers it. Free, open source (MIT), Hebrew-first docs.

## Key facts

- Demo mode works end to end with fictional data: `pip install -e . && daily-brief --demo`
- Live Mashov adapter is experimental: timetable/homework shapes verified against a live read-only pull (25.10.2026, fictional fixtures); day-numbering needs one-time calibration (MASHOV_DAY1_IS); conversation envelope backed by public library evidence, not yet live-verified; attachments are marked, never downloaded.
- No central server, no signup; every user runs their own instance. Connecting a cloud bot or delivery provider moves the chosen data through them.
- Grades and discipline events are intentionally not collected (privacy decision).
- Tests: `python -m unittest discover tests` (50 tests, fictional fixtures only).

## Files

- README.md - hero, demo image, status table, FAQ (Hebrew)
- AGENTS.md - guided onboarding for code agents (clone, deps, config, demo, live test, scheduling)
- skills/daily-brief/SKILL.md - Agent Skills format instructions
- recipes/daily-brief.he.md - plain-text recipe for chat-based bots
- examples/demo-brief.txt - exact demo output
- CONTRIBUTING.md - contribution rules (no real data ever, tests pass, fail-closed adapters)
- SECURITY.md - private vulnerability reporting and known limits
